svg.title: Selection and development-pressure break-even
svg.desc: A sensitivity map shows the additional post-2050 environmental decline needed to cancel mainstream fertility selection by 2150. A model ladder shows that measured mainstream selection and named groups raise the stable-low projection, while the illustrative four-percent development-pressure scenario lowers it substantially.
